explanation: Botero insisted he painted volume, a love of full, swelling form. Fruit and cats swell in his work too, and he gave his home city, Medellín, a square of bronze figures.

claims.text: Fernando Botero's figures are characteristically plump and rounded.
Botero's figures are not typically broken into cubes, built from dots or made of bent wire.
Botero described his subject as volume rather than the figures' size.
Botero painted still lifes and animals in the same swelling style.
Botero donated a group of his bronze sculptures, installed in a square in Medellín, the city where he was born.
